status.en: 11 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 57% more than the week before, most of them in Dioura, Niamey and Kidal.
status.nb: 11 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 57 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Dioura, Niamey og Kidal.

summary.en: ISWAP commanders were killed by the Nigerian army in Borno while the group also killed a Nigerian soldier and several terrorists in separate attacks. Mali installed an ex-colonel as president and denied Ukrainian support for armed groups, while Niger signed a strategic cooperation protocol with Haftar's forces and received its first fuel shipment from Algeria under military escort. Russian President Putin is seeking ties with African states and Burkina Faso is sending youth to a Russia-Africa summit for training, indicating deeper security cooperation. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: ISWAP-kommandanter ble drept av den nigerianske hæren i Borno, mens gruppen også drepte en nigeriansk soldat og flere terrorister i separate angrep. Mali innførte en eks-kolonel som president og avviste ukrainsk støtte til væpnede grupper, mens Niger signerte en protokoll om strategisk samarbeid med Haftars styrker og mottok sin første drivstoffleveranse fra Algerie under militær eskortering. Russlands president Putin søker bånd med afrikanske stater, og Burkina Faso sender ungdom til et Russland-Afrika-toppmøte for opplæring, noe som indikerer dypere sikkerhetssamarbeid. Konflikten førte til 4 159 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.extract: The War in the Sahel, also known as the Sahel War, is a multi-sided armed conflict that has been ongoing since 2012. The conflict mainly takes place in the countries of Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso.
